A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Neuroplastic Expansion in Deep Reinforcement Learning. All 23 pages, including Appendices A-F, are available and readable; corresponding text, equations, figures, tables, and pseudocode support reliable comparison.

before.justification: V2 reports original reinforcement-learning experiments, continual-adaptation evaluations, and component and sensitivity analyses in the main text and Appendix F.

after.justification: V3 retains these original experimental results, including MuJoCo and visual-control comparisons, continual adaptation, and appendix ablations.

M1.justification: Gradient-guided topology expansion, dormant-neuron pruning and truncation, and experience-review sampling remain unchanged. Section 3.2 and Algorithms 1-2 specify the same procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same five MuJoCo environments, four-task continual-adaptation sequence, DMC visual-control tasks, and supplementary sparse-reward Hammer and Sweep Into tasks. No evaluation domain or scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain Reset, ReDo, Layer Normalization, and Plasticity Injection; continual adaptation retains vanilla TD3 and Reset. Static-network, random-growth, and component comparisons also retain their comparator sets.

E3.justification: The long-term training budgets, three continual-adaptation cycles with 1,000 episodes per task, evaluation metrics, architectures, preprocessing, and hyperparameters are unchanged. Appendix C retains the same experimental settings.

E4.justification: The growth/pruning, experience-review, and actor-versus-critic ablations are retained. Appendix F contains the same sensitivity analyses for growth rate, initial sparsity, growth schedule, replay ratio, and network size, plus the same gradient and behavior visualizations.

E5.justification: Both versions retain seven-seed main comparisons and the same mean/standard-deviation reporting. Appendix F preserves its three-, five-, and ten-run or seed summaries; no uncertainty-reporting practice or statistical procedure changes.

E6.justification: Result entries, plotted curves, and task-level findings are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 8 retains Ant final returns of 7749.25 ± 127.73 with experience review and 7235.14 ± 493.83 without it. Figure 6's caption clarification does not change the underlying results.

T1.justification: Mathematical definitions, objectives, and reasoning remain unchanged. Equation 2 replaces a colon with an equals sign and removes a trailing semicolon, without changing its growth/pruning definitions. No theorem or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about mitigating plasticity loss, preserving stability, and improving task performance through NE's three components. The added code announcement concerns access rather than scientific claims.

C2.justification: Explanations of neuron dormancy, experience-review stabilization, continual adaptation, and critic sensitivity are retained. Appendix E still acknowledges imperfect growth-candidate selection, and the conclusion retains the same future directions concerning adaptive capacity and computational overhead.

D1.justification: V3 adds an abstract statement that code is publicly available, hyperlinked to the project's GitHub repository; v2 lacks this project-code access point. Architecture, hyperparameter, hardware/software, training-time, and pseudocode disclosures remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Appendix A removes the Yun et al. (2025) citation from the plasticity-loss and fine-tuning discussion, retaining Dohare et al. (2024). The Yun bibliography entry remains. Other related-work coverage and research positioning are unchanged.

P1.justification: V3 makes limited paragraph regrouping, punctuation, and caption-wording edits, alongside the new abstract sentence. Section order and nearly all prose remain intact; shifted page breaks do not represent substantive restructuring.

P2.justification: Figure 1 is enlarged and repositioned, with modest figure/text reflow elsewhere. Figure 6 changes 'all four tasks' to 'four tasks' despite displaying five tasks in both versions; Figure 8 shortens ordinal labels. Some appendix figure references become hyperlinks. No figure or table is added or removed.

improvement.justification: The new project-code link provides a reproducibility access point absent from v2, while the Figure 6 caption correction and linked appendix references modestly improve clarity and navigation. Scientific methods and evidence remain unchanged. Repository completeness and usability cannot be verified from the PDFs.
